performance.verdict: CPL efficiency is real, but zero GHL won opps and 3 overdue milestones threaten August scoreboard.

findings.text: Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) remains open; 71 GBP calls in 28 days are untracked, breaking the lead-to-patient scoreboard.
Sync items + contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) not completed; 293 GHL contacts but 0 won opportunities signals intake data is still unreliable.
CPL improved to ~$10.77 (28-day) and -34.8% week-over-week, but spend dropped to $25.71/day — efficiency gain is partly a volume reduction artifact.
3-day signal (Aug 22–24): spend averaged $26.50/day vs $29.37 prior 3 days; leads were 0, 6, 8 vs 4, 0, 5 — spend contracting but lead output holding so far.
IG reach collapsed from ~350/day (late July) to 88 avg over last 5 days (-56.5% week-over-week); organic visibility shrinking with no paid Instagram offset.

suggestions.text: Close phone-match attribution gap immediately; 71 untracked GBP calls in 28 days are voiding the August scoreboard.
suggestions.monday_update: The phone-match attribution gap flagged for 2026-08-07 is still open. GBP logged 71 calls in the last 28 days that are not tied to any lead or opportunity in GHL, making the lead-to-patient chain invisible to the client. Assign Attribution to implement call tracking match logic before end of week. Success check: zero unmatched GBP call events in GHL by 2026-08-29.

suggestions.text: Complete GHL sync + contact cleanup; 293 contacts, 0 won opps, 0 appointments logged breaks August renewal proof.
suggestions.monday_update: The sync items and contact cleanup milestone due 2026-08-14 is unresolved. GHL shows 293 contacts and 93 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments recorded, which means the pipeline is not reflecting real intake activity. CRM & Automation (Ahmed/Ali) must complete tagging cleanup and verify appointment write-back is live. Success check: at least one appointment confirmed in GHL pipeline matching an OpenDental record by 2026-08-28.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta daily spend: if 3-day avg stays below $25/day, confirm whether budget was manually cut or pacing — then decide scale.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend averaged $26.50/day over Aug 22–24, down from a high of ~$75/day in late July, and CPL improved to $10.77 — but lead volume depends on spend recovering. Confirm with buyer whether this is a deliberate budget reduction or platform pacing. If spend stays under $25/day through 2026-08-28 without a manual reduction on record, escalate to Sohib for budget authorization. Re-check 2026-08-28.
